7. Vāruṇidūsakajātaka Spoiling the Toddy: a past life story

“Na ve anatthakusalena, Surely not with one who misunderstands the meaning atthacariyā sukhāvahā; does good conduct lead to happiness. Hāpeti atthaṁ dummedho, The simpleton destroys the good, koṇḍañño vāruṇiṁ yathā”ti. as Koṇḍañña did the toddy.

Vāruṇidūsakajātakaṁ sattamaṁ.
